description: Documentation coverage checks for GDPR data protection requirements. Checks whether data protection and privacy requirements are identified and described in the project artifacts. These checks assess documentation coverage only — they do not determine GDPR compliance.

rules.title: Personal Data Categories
rules.description: All personal data categories processed must be identified and documented.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for personal data categories, PII definitions, or sensitive data classifications.
rules.recommendation: Identify and document all personal data categories processed by this feature.

rules.title: Purpose of Processing
rules.description: The purpose of each data processing activity must be documented.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for documented purposes for each data processing activity.
rules.recommendation: Clearly document the purpose for each category of personal data processed.

rules.title: Lawful Basis for Processing
rules.description: A lawful basis must be identified for each processing activity.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for lawful basis statements, consent mechanisms, or legitimate interest assessments.
rules.recommendation: State the lawful basis for each processing activity (e.g., consent, legitimate interest, contractual).

rules.title: Data Retention Periods
rules.description: Data retention periods must be defined and enforced.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for retention period definitions, deletion schedules, or storage limitation policies.
rules.recommendation: Define data retention periods and deletion schedules for all personal data.

rules.title: Personal Data Access Control
rules.description: Access to personal data must be documented and restricted.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for access restriction requirements, need-to-know policies, or personal data access controls.
rules.recommendation: Document which roles or systems have access to personal data and under what conditions.

rules.title: Data Access Audit Logging
rules.description: Logging of personal data access and processing must be specified.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for data access logging requirements or personal data processing records.
rules.recommendation: Specify logging requirements for personal data access and processing events.

rules.title: Data Subject Rights
rules.description: How data subject rights will be handled must be documented.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for data subject rights handling, erasure requests, or portability requirements.
rules.recommendation: Document how data subject rights (access, erasure, portability, rectification) are handled.

rules.title: Third-Party Data Sharing
rules.description: Third-party services receiving personal data must be documented.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for third-party data sharing, data processor agreements, or external data transfers.
rules.recommendation: Document any third-party services receiving personal data, along with data sharing agreements.

rules.title: Privacy by Design & Default
rules.description: Privacy-by-design principles must be applied and documented.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for privacy-by-design principles, data minimization, or DPIA mentions.
rules.recommendation: Describe how privacy-by-design principles (data minimization, privacy defaults) are applied.
